detail.longDescription: How can I set the font size for all of the elements in the UI? I also want to avoid setting the font at the app level; I want to have multiple fonts in my app, and I also would like to setting font size element by element. from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMainWindow, QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QLabel, QLineEdit from PyQt6.QtGui import QFont import sys class AutomaticFont(QMainWindow): def __init__(self): super().__init__() widget = QWidget() self.setCentralWidget(widget) layout = QVBoxLayout() widget.setLayout(layout) font1 = QFont("Arial", 24) font2 = QFont("Arial", 12) label = QLabel("This is a test text") label.setFont(font1) line_edit = QLineEdit() line_edit.setFont(font2) line_edit.textChanged.connect(lambda: font1.setPointSize(int(line_edit.text()))) layout.addWidget(label) layout.addWidget(line_edit) self.show() if __name__ == '__main__': app = QApplication(sys.argv) font = AutomaticFont() app.exec()
